name: integrity
command: git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/baseline-before-implement && git tag -l --format=%(contents) baseline-before-implement && git diff --name-only --relative baseline-before-implement -- tests specs .harness .specify/memory/constitution.md pyproject.toml && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- tests specs .harness .specify/memory/constitution.md pyproject.toml && git diff -U0 --relative baseline-before-implement -- src tests && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- src tests
